title: Fulfillment
description: Fulfillment model. An order splits into one or more fulfillment groups, each with its own type (warehouse/dropship/pickup), ship-to, carrier, and shipments. This is what makes hybrid orders (some lines from warehouse, some dropshipped) expressible in V1.

fulfillmentGroups.description: One entry per distinct fulfillment path. A simple single-warehouse order has exactly one group.

groupId.description: Unique id within the order. Order items reference this via fulfillmentGroupId.

shipTo.description: Destination for this group. May differ per group (e.g. multi-warehouse split-ship).

warehouseId.description: Source warehouse/location for WAREHOUSE or PICKUP groups.

vendorId.description: Vendor responsible for a DROPSHIP group. Null for warehouse groups.

shippingMethod.description: Requested service level (e.g. GROUND, 2DAY, LTL_FREIGHT). Free-form for V1.

shipments.description: Actual physical shipments executed for this group. Empty until shipped.

shippedItems.description: Which lines and how many units went in this shipment. Enables partial-ship tracking.

freightCost.description: Actual freight cost for this shipment, if known.
